The pistons are light, move without friction and are in equilibrium, and the atmosphere acts on the outer face of each piston. Take g = 9.8 m/s². A bottle jack stands beside the lift. The oil stays in the lift and is incompressible.

detail.clause: A bottle jack stands beside the lift. The oil stays in the lift and is incompressible.
detail.rationale: A bottle jack standing beside the lift has its own oil and ram; it is not joined to the lift, so the force needed on the small piston of the lift is unchanged.

pairs.d_rationale: The load is placed on the jack, which is not joined to the lift; the load on the lift and the force needed on its small piston are the stated ones.
pairs.d_sentence: Before the force is applied, a further 340 kg load is placed on the jack.
pairs.n_sentence: Before the force is applied, a further small load is placed on the jack.
pairs.r_sentence: Before the force is applied, a further 340 kg load is placed on the large piston.

pairs.d_rationale: The load was placed for an earlier experiment only, which is over; the lift of the stated problem carries the stated load.
pairs.d_sentence: A further 340 kg load was placed on the large piston for an earlier experiment only.
pairs.n_sentence: A further small load was placed on the large piston for an earlier experiment only.
pairs.r_sentence: A further 340 kg load was placed on the large piston before the force was applied.
